previous_milestone.interpretation: First scoped local bridge passed on UF250_020, but exact local boundary semantics collapsed to TRUE because internal branch (0,1) satisfied the local region for every boundary assignment.

objective: Test whether a frozen exact symmetry cell can induce a compact exact nonconstant, genuinely joint boundary relation without a universally TRUE internal branch and without reduction to independent unary admissibility sets.

specimen_selection.rule: Use the lowest-index frozen UF250 source, excluding already-used UF250_020, whose frozen WL1 and WL2 nontrivial variable cell agrees and whose frozen E3 generator graph proves the full symmetric action on that cell.

interface_language.name: OR_OF_CANONICAL_RESIDUAL_CSP_ORBIT_BRANCHES
interface_language.compression_principle: Under a verified full S3 action, assignments are grouped by Hamming weight. A representative is retained only after exact residual identity is independently confirmed for every assignment in the same orbit.

pass_requires: full S3 action reproduced from sealed reduced CSP
all assignments of equal Hamming weight have identical canonical residual semantics
no raw branch yields TRUE over the full boundary
the existential union of retained orbit branches is nonconstant
the exact boundary relation is not equivalent to the product of independent unary projections
candidate emits compact exact symbolic interface without full boundary-cube enumeration
independent checker reconstructs and verifies the same interface without importing candidate
